explanation:
The central tree reduces the seed from 134 to 94 lines (29.9%) and from 9,847 to 6,686 characters (32.1%). Six peripheral trees expand meaningful concept lines: interface state, frozen inputs, execution, experiment attempts, comparison evidence and output retention. [M] = modular structure; [C] = call flow; [O] = ownership/lifetime; [D] = data dependency across those organizational views. Positions use measured text dimensions, leaving at least 10 columns between bands and five rows between stacked peripherals. Edge lines are 1-based.

Evidence is limited to the point definition and eight source texts in context.json, with seed.json as the starting tree. New details include polling revision guards and intervals (EvalsPage.tsx:70-97), merge ancestry and stage-only hashing (evalPromptService.ts:14, 131-164), checkpoint revision boundaries (compareSessionService.ts:32-42), runtime isolation and cache-key composition (agentContextEvalRuntime.ts:18-35), planned-cell coverage and judgement ownership (experimentService.ts:58-99), and stricter placement-backfill requirements (evalRunService.ts:153-175).

Corrections and qualifications: 'relaunch selected stage' can imply stage-only execution, but launchEdited requests the workflow with one ordinary pass and experiment relaunch remaps matching stages (evalRunService.ts:295-300, 441-443; experimentService.ts:208-215). The diagrams therefore say workflow rerun. The seed's blanket late-response guarantee is narrowed to usePolled's closed guard; it suppresses updates without aborting the request. Mixed success becomes partial only after queued/generating cells are gone (evalRun.ts:94-99). Judgement run/cell links are optional when reconciliation cannot resolve ownership (judgementService.ts:31-35). Public API labels use setArchived and deleteRun. Validation retries cover validator failures; runtime exceptions escape that loop (evalRunService.ts:654-668).

Imported implementations outside the supplied texts remain dependency boundaries. The internal few-shot algorithm, validator/materializer behavior, base session persistence and catalog publication atomicity are not established here. The result passes output-schema.json validation; ASCII, edge endpoints and diagram non-overlap were checked.
